one_liner: Issue tracking and project management tool built for software teams.

auth.evidence_quote: Use OAuth 2.0 or personal API keys to authenticate your requests to the Linear API
auth.notes: OAuth2 is used for apps acting on behalf of other workspaces; personal API keys are single-account.

access.evidence_quote: You can explore Linear's capabilities with a free account.
access.notes: No documented separate app-review step found within budget; standard OAuth workspace-admin consent likely applies.

api.evidence_quote: comprehensive GraphQL API for querying and modifying data
api.notes: Linear publishes an official MCP server; API is GraphQL (single endpoint), so 'endpoint_count' is not applicable in the REST sense.

verdict.rationale: Free account, documented OAuth2 GraphQL API, and an official MCP server all indicate low-friction buildability.
